items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the inverse tangent of of y / x, where y and x are the first and second values passed to the expression respectively.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算 y / x 的反正切值，其中 y 和 x 分别是传递给该表达式的第一个和第二个值。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the inverse tangent of the the numeric value divided by the given AggregationExpression in the argument.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算数值除以参数中给定的AggregationExpression的反正切值。

items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a value that is measured in ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS.
items.translation: 创建一个新AggregationExpression，用于计算以ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS为单位的值的双曲正切。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the inverse tangent of the the numeric value divided by the given numeric value in the argument.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算参数中给定数值除以该数值的反正切值。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the inverse tangent of the the numeric value divided by the given field reference in the argument.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于计算数值除以给定字段引用后的反正切值。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Uses of ArithmeticOperators.ATan2 in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ArithmeticOperators.ATan2 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 包中的用法
